description: Aléa sismicité à la commune sur Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes en 2010 is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by DREAL Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes. Le plan séisme lancé en 2005 a présenté une nouvelle carte de l'aléa sismique. Sa classification varie par commune de la valeur faible à moyen pour les communes de la zone de défense. Coverage: DREAL Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes. The publisher named on the listing is DREAL Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes. Its keywords include auvergne-rhone-alpes, inspire, gestion-de-crise, zones-a-risque-naturel, pacinno. The listing shows 2 download or service links in MAPINFO TAB. The listing shows 2013-04-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
